# Learning {.unnumbered}

::: {.callout-note}
Standalone foundational references for engineers, architects, and assessors. These docs are intentionally **UIAO-agnostic** — they cover the underlying technology, protocols, cryptography, APIs, and ecosystem patterns that any team encounters when modernizing legacy stacks. UIAO's substrate transformations build *on top of* this knowledge; this section is where you start if you need the foundation first.

Companion documents that layer UIAO transformation assistance on top of these references will appear separately under each topic.
:::

## Pages in this section

| Slug | Topic | Audience |
|---|---|---|
| [`old-ad-vs-new-entra-reference`](old-ad-vs-new-entra-reference.html) | Old AD vs New EntraID — languages (C++, VB, .NET, Python, PowerShell, YAML, Bicep), authentication and federation protocols (Kerberos, NTLM, LDAP, SAML, WS-Fed, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, PKCE, FIDO2, SCIM, DPoP, CAE), cryptography (MD4/RC4/SHA-1 to RS256/ES384, HSM boundaries), directory APIs (ADSI/DirectoryServices vs MSAL/Graph), IaC and YAML CI/CD, Entra ID Protection, identity lifecycle and governance, OSCAL compliance authoring, hybrid bridges. 15 generated diagrams. | Architects, engineers, assessors transitioning from on-prem Active Directory to Microsoft Entra ID |

## How to use this section

Start with the document most relevant to your transition. Each reference is **self-contained** — no prior knowledge of UIAO required — and structured so you can read top-to-bottom for a survey or jump to specific sections (cryptography, protocols, OSCAL, etc.) via the table of contents.

When you're ready to see how UIAO's substrate accelerates the transition, look for the companion documents under each topic. Those documents reference back into Learning rather than duplicating the foundation.
